# Forward Projection — Term Outlook Fixture

## Multi-Year Electoral Scenario Map (2026–2029)

**Baseline electoral scenario (55 %):** EP10 concludes with centrist coalition EPP-S&D-Renew retaining governing majority. EP2029 election produces comparable seat distribution to 2024. Commission President re-nomination avoids protracted bloc warfare.

**Progressive shift scenario (20 %):** Renew recovery in France and Germany produces stronger liberal bloc. Green resurgence in Nordic and Benelux countries. Centre-left majority becomes viable without EPP dependency.

**Nationalist surge scenario (25 %):** ECR-PfE bloc consolidates seats in Southern and Central European member states. Centrist coalition loses majority — grand coalition (EPP+S&D+Renew+Greens) required for stable governance. Commission President nomination contested.

## Term-Arc Inflection Points

- **2026 Q4**: Austrian and German post-elections stabilise or shift bloc compositions.
- **2027 Q2**: Mid-term mandate review — Commission Work Programme adjustment.
- **2028 Q1**: European election campaign season begins; Spitzenkandidaten declarations expected.
- **2029 Q2**: EP election. New Parliament constituted July 2029.
